name: Mistral AI
description: Read-only Mistral AI access: the account's catalogue of available Mistral and Mixtral models. Sending a chat completion is a billable POST against the account's usage, so it is modelled as write:true and HITL-gated rather than fired here; this is an OpenAI-compatible template child of the openai/groq/deepseek connector shape, and the EU frontier-lab fit for sovereignty-minded buyers.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the Mistral and Mixtral models available to this API key, with capabilities and context length

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Send a chat completion to a Mistral-hosted model. This spends the account's token usage, so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness (write:true means blind proof always SKIPs it; a real credential would also need --include-writes)

model.description: Mistral model id to route to (e.g. mistral-large-latest), from list_models

needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real key against /models, a zero-spend authed read per the coverage-gap plan.
TEMPLATE CHILD: this spec inherits the openrouter.connector.json Authorization: Bearer + GET /models shape near-verbatim, per the coverage-gap plan's template-child list.

chat_completion is the only write:true tool: it is modelled for completeness but deliberately carries no _probe and is skipped by the shape-proof harness by default (writes_not_included), and even with --include-writes it only fires if the test call already proved an auth gate.
